title: Local Implementation Dossiers: Service, Output, And Mission, 2022-2026
summary: Twenty-four official records deepen three existing local journeys: Northern Virginia compute demand to service, Nevada lithium authorization to qualified output, and Florida Space Coast planning to mission use.
scope: Phase 55X adds eight records per journey. Northern Virginia receives a current PJM forecast, generator-permit guidance, a named transmission case, the active Loudoun standards process, one multi-permit comparator, and three named 2026 air permits. Nevada receives two Rhyolite Ridge permit files and six Thacker Pass decision, reclamation, fact-sheet, air-permit, and technical-review records. Florida receives the LC-39A Starship environmental decision, Kennedy master-plan environmental review, two state planning and delivery records, the planned SIMO services acquisition, one operational access asset, one mission-preparation facility record, and one active-countdown resilience operation.
download_note: The 27-file archive contains 24 official-link records, consolidated FTFN summaries, a README, and a SHA-256 manifest. Two records remain explicitly In Review: the Rhyolite Ridge air-permit file because its displayed status is unresolved, and NASA SIMO because it remains a planned acquisition.
method_note: Each dossier preserves stage boundaries. A forecast is not service; an application is not an approval; a permit is not construction or compliance; an environmental decision is not an operator license; a procurement plan is not an award; a built asset is not a measured system outcome; and one operating event is not a sustained performance trend.
